name: pirate_audio_screensaver
description: Idle clock screensaver for Pimoroni Pirate Audio ST7789 displays on Volumio
author: arut16

volumio_info.details: Displays an idle clock on Pimoroni Pirate Audio ST7789 displays with configurable idle delay, display rotation and individually selectable bundled fonts with 12:34 previews.
volumio_info.changelog: 0.1.6: Select individual bundled clock fonts, preview 12:34 in a three-column gallery, persist font selection, and share the display with Pirate Audio to avoid exclusive GPIO conflicts.
